body.statement: Construct \(R\) whenever \(G\equiv_E H\) and \(e\in E(H)\setminus E(G)\), transforming every \(\sigma\)-open walk in \(\operatorname{Lift}(G+e)\) given \(D(B,C)\) into one in \(\operatorname{Lift}(G)\) with the same endpoint copies and conditioning. The construction must cover SCC-changing arrows, directed self-loops, the two copywise and one cross-copy lifted edges generated by a bidirected loop, collider activation, SCC-tail changes, and first bidirected connections outside occupied SCC rectangles.
body.justification: This is the genuinely open proof mechanism.
body.gap: Only \(\mu\)-splicing and fixed-profile E-replacements are published.
body.consumer: It yields unrestricted transfer and certificates for optional edges.

obligation.what_is_open: Construct the marked, copy-aware replacement for an edge whose addition changes the mixed SCC profile, especially an SCC-merging arrow or the first bidirected edge in a previously unoccupied cross-SCC rectangle.
obligation.obstruction: E-equivalence supplies equality of endpoint separation queries, but it does not directly supply a walk with the two endpoint marks, copy indices, and conditioned-tail behavior needed at an occurrence of the new edge.  The comparison graph containing the edge may omit other edges used by the surrounding walk in the base graph, so its witness cannot simply be spliced.  The frozen contextual-replacement definition records desired certificates but does not prove that they exist.
obligation.attempted: A shortest newly open walk was cut at its first new-edge occurrence, and singleton E-equivalence was applied to the exposed endpoints.  This does not control the incident marks or whether a tail is internal after an SCC change.  Minimal-counterexample comparison with the graph union has the same defect.  The requested exhaustive gate passed all 384,168 five-vertex bases with at most five edges in the 35-edge loop-excluding universe, including 11,592,420 one-edge checks and unions of matching-signature bases.  A separate loop-aware extension passed all 760,099 such bases in the 40-edge frozen universe, including 26,717,120 one-edge checks and matching-signature unions.  These finite checks found no counterexample but do not prove the universal replacement claim.
obligation.partial_result: For every \(e\in E(\Gamma(G))\setminus E(G)\), the explicit substitutions in the proof of \(\text{prop:fixed-profile}\) transform every \(\sigma\)-open walk in \(\operatorname{Lift}(G+e)\), given any \(D(B,C)\), into a \(\sigma\)-open walk in \(\operatorname{Lift}(G)\) with the same endpoint copies.  The construction covers within-SCC arrows, incoming-to-SCC arrows, directed loops in non-singleton SCCs, and completion of already occupied cross-SCC bidirected rectangles.  It does not cover SCC-changing arrows or first bidirected edges between previously unconnected SCC rectangles.
